title: Research: price H2-sem copy-path helper-sharing wraps (no new kappa)
body:
## Summary

**Priced finite invoice under the H2-sem replacement interface; no new κ.** Complements open [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1782](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1782), which admitted the PR848 wraps under H2-sem but left F/B envelopes and the paid profile uncomputed.

Under H2-sem: single pair 277→434 saves **65 ADDs** (24305→24240); seed-42 greedy matching (205 pairs) saves **6231 ADDs** (24305→18074). Complete dirty F2 boundary and semantic N are unchanged; paid profile mass **5129** is unchanged; local/nine-stage guards remain strict (94/177 and 95/180). Intermediate F rises with the large matching even as ADD count falls; that trade-off is recorded.

Against the H2 barrier of [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#848](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/848) and the contract of [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1194](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1194).

## Task

- Card: `bit-helper-contract` (chooser seed `978940692bb73d58cd4b4e07f8514e57`)
- Base: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`
- Package: `research/h2sem-copyshare-priced/`
- Head: `b34e0620` on `cursor/h2sem-copyshare-priced-60b9`

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/h2sem-copyshare-priced/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/h2sem-copyshare-priced/verify.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h2sem-copyshare-priced
```

Expected: `PASS_H2SEM_COPYSHARE_PRICED ... profile_mass=5129 ... no_new_kappa` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

## Scope limits

No kappa/frontier/native/hosted/compiler/tape claim. Paid profile unchanged; bit side nonbinding. Matching optimality not claimed. Does not re-derive the #1782/#1194 chronological bridge; prices wraps under that admitted interface.

## Overlap and credit

Complementary to [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1782](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1782), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#848](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/848), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1194](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1194).
